title: Elicitation
excerpt: Elicitation A tool handler asks the end user a question mid call with ctx.mcpReq.elicitInput — the connected client puts the question in front of them and the promise resolves with their answer. Ask for input with a form Form mode carries a message and a requestedSchema: a flat JSON Schema of primitive fields the client renders as a form. result.action records what the end user did — accept, decline, or cancel — and result.content carries the submitted fields on accept only. The SDK validates accepted content again...
